transfer_notes: Transfer standard mechanisms and resolution/LR ladder; do not reproduce the external score or artifact hashes.
Use all 148695 audited official training rows. No author 4071-image exclusion list, no label relabelling.
Use project frozen grouped 133815/14880 split for dev stages; no regenerated random split.
Use original images and project-native OpenAI CLIP; no JPEG cache or Hugging Face model/dependency.
Reference hyperparameters are starting values, not measured optima on this project. Microbatch2/activation checkpointing still need local CUDA cost/memory validation.
Final five-epoch full-data stage includes former holdout. It has no independent local validation score; final inference uses one raw last checkpoint.
Project rules leave EMA/SWA/weight averaging unconfirmed. Every stage trains, selects and transfers raw weights only.
